newsitem.title: USA: Time Warner stock jumps on Q1 release.
newsitem.headline: Time Warner stock jumps on Q1 release.

text.p: Time Warner Inc 's stock rose Wednesday after the company released first quarter earnings showing a smaller-than-expected loss and increased cash flow.
In morning trading, the stock was up about 1-3/4 to 42-1/2, and about 900,000 shares had changed hands.
One trader said investors were encouraged by the company's 27 percent growth in earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization to $1.14 billion from $899 million.
"They just demonstrated that they've got a pretty good cash cow operating," said Doug Myers, a trader with Interstate/Johnson Lane.
The company reported a net loss of $43 million, or $0.08 per share, on revenues of $3.03 billion, versus a net loss of $153 million, or $0.39 per share, on revenues of $2.07 billion.
The analysts' mean estimate was a loss of $0.32 per share, according to First Call.
"People were waiting for the shoe to drop," Myers said. "Once it does drop in a positive fashion, they say, 'OK, go get me some stock.'"
((-- Lisa Marie Pane, New York newsdesk 212-859-1713))
